name: Student Residence Permit (Third-Country National)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires enrolment in full-time higher education at a recognised institution: at least 54 credits (or, for a preparatory year, at least 12 credit hours per week during the academic year). Enrolment at a private (unrecognised) institution does not confer student status.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to a recognised Belgian higher-education institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Sufficient means of subsistence is listed as a favourable factor in the application assessment.

evidence_required.document: Admission letter from a recognised institution (54+ credits full-time)
Proof of sufficient means of subsistence

outcome.duration_length: not specified at tier-1 precision in this pass; renewable for continuing studies, with a post-graduation 'search year' extension available

sources.title: IBZ -- Study (third-country nationals): 54-credit full-time enrolment standard, sufficient-means factor, private-institution exclusion, post-graduation search-year extension
